method: Babel TSX AST over every own Pdf*.tsx excluding tests. Every UI control opening tag, option/menu label declaration, JSX/option map family, JSX-producing conditional/if branch and state hook is indexed. CSS/supporting files are hashed, not counted as UI records. Includes hidden legacy JSX and document-dependent families; counts are SOURCE mappings, never GUI passes or expanded native options.

{() => {
                    const open = !blocksShown
                    setImagesOpen(false)
                    setFormsOpen(false)
                    setAnnotationsOpen(false)
                    setImageExportOpen(false)
                    setLocalMode(null)
                    setInsertMode(false)
                    setSelectTextMode(false)
                    setBlocksOpen(open)
                    setBlockSelection(null)
                    setNotice(null)
                  }}

controls.label: 替换原文
controls.disabled:
{
                    !replacementDraft.trim() ||
                    replacementDraft === activeSelectedText.text ||
                    replacementDraft.includes(activeSelectedText.text) ||
                    replacementDraft.length > 10_000 ||
                    contentBusy ||
                    source.saving ||
                    settled !== null ||
                    pendingInserts.length > 0
                  }
